kind: One run at full size and full length, one seed: the lifted loop with power-law cells if the bed's four-seed reading holds, else fsp-lift's second seed; trained and scored as fsp-lift, beside fsp-lift and v19's pair.
why: fsp-lift (full_size_lifted_loop_run.json) runs in the form its pilots picked: two passes, a budget of 507,000, 6e-4, the pool that lifts the ceiling (fll-decide: a third pass 0.0008 better, the Transformer's rate 0.0031 better, neither 0.005). Of the changes piloted at full size beside it after 24,000 updates against fs-loop6-lift (1.300729), one passed: power-law cells (--granule-power 8), 0.0137 better [-0.0145, -0.0129] at equal parameters and 0.4% more pulses (full_size_power_cells.json). The others stay out: twice the budget 0.0005 worse (full_size_loop_budget.json), weight decay on synapses only 0.0017 worse (full_size_decay_synapses_only.json), energy pools 0.0040 worse (energy_pool.json); loop phases failed on the bed (loop_phases_with_data.json). By power_cells_with_data.json's amendment, power-law cells join the next full-length run only if the bed's four-seed reading (seeds 20001 to 20004 at 24,000 updates, --min-wins 3) is a fix or a constant gain as well; that reading lands tonight, after this record. If it fails, nothing passed, and the run is fsp-lift's second seed, which gives the spread of full-length runs that every comparison at this length has lacked. The code copy of f876392 scores fs-loop6-lift's weights bit for bit as fsp-lift's copy of 97a2772 does (8,000 validation bytes as 4 streams on the server's CPU), so the pilot's pair does not mix in a change of code.

arm.fsp-lift2: If the four-seed reading is a fix or a constant gain: CODE=v18c sched/bin/full-pair3.sh stack fsp-lift2 6e-4 --stack-loop 2,8,2 --pulse-budget 507000 --pool-lifts-ceiling --granule-power 8, the flags in both stages, seed 20001 (fsp-lift's), on the code copy of f876392 that trained the full-size pilot. Otherwise fsp-lift's second seed: fsp-lift's flags without --granule-power on fsp-lift's code copy (v17n, 97a2772) with seed 20002, through a copy of full-pair3.sh that takes the seed from SEED (full-pair3.sh fixes 20001 and is not edited while fsp-lift runs it). Either way 36,263,956 parameters in the long stage: power-law cells add none.

training: Server GPU 0, alone (MPS=0), priority 5, GPU_MEM 85, queued after tonight's window closes so that it starts first when the window of Thursday 2026-11-26 opens at 16:45 UTC, and runs through the weekend's window by pause and resume; fsp-loop took 16.3 hours of training and about 1.5 of scoring. The bed work left on GPU 0 waits until it is done.
base: fsp-lift (scored in Thursday's window), fsp-loop, fsp-st and fsp-tf: the same data, schedule and scoring, and with power-law cells the same seed as fsp-lift.
measure: As full_size_lifted_loop_run.json: the full enwik8 test and validation splits as streams at the reach chosen on the first 1,000,000 validation bytes (the trained 2,048 or 8,192), with fast output synapses at 2^24 on the cells of every pass and without, paired piece by piece with fsp-lift, fsp-loop and fsp-tf (experiments/compare_stream_scores.py) and split by context (experiments/gap_by_piece.py, near 2,032, far 8,192); the pulses a byte, the training time and the share of membrane entries at their bound (experiments/membrane_saturation.py). With power-law cells also the cells' firing beside fsp-lift's (experiments/cell_activity.py on the first 8,192 validation bytes, lead 256, piece 256).
reading: (1) It beats the Transformer if its taught test score is below fsp-tf's frozen score with the paired 95% interval of the gap below zero, and the same holds on validation; the gap to fsp-tf with fast output synapses at 0.07 is recorded beside, the claim is made without reservation only if it holds against that too, and every claim states the pulses a byte. (2) With power-law cells: they improve the lifted loop at full length if fsp-lift2 is at least 0.005 better than fsp-lift on taught test and on taught validation, each interval clear of zero; within 0.003 on either split they do not, and between it is unclear. As fsp-lift's second seed: the two seeds' differences on both splits with their intervals are the spread, and no claim of a change is made. (3) If (2) holds, fsp-lift2's form is the stack's recipe from here on; otherwise the better-scored of the two seeds is reported and fsp-lift's form stays.
seen_before_recording: power_cells_screen.json (the laptop's seed: 0.0262 ahead at 6,000 updates, 0.0045 at 24,000), power_cells_with_data.json's result_two_seeds (a constant gain, 0.0128 on the mean at 24,000) and full_size_power_cells.json's result with the cells' firing; the other full-size pilots and bed screens named above; fsp-lift's training to update 63,000 (its in-training estimates only, not scored). Of seeds 3 and 4: the bases bed24-lr12-g3 and -g4 are trained and scored but not read; pw8-24k-g3 and -g4 are training, and the scheduler's status line showed their in-training estimates (1.6052 at update 21,000 and 1.8389 at 6,750), not paired with anything; pw8-6k-g3, pw8-6k-g4, rd-base-6k-g3 and rd-base-6k-g4 have not trained. The four-seed reading has not been computed.
